page.overview:
Who is Indominus rex Twins?

Unknown (Grey individual)|status=Alive (White individual) Unknown (Grey individual)|born=2012}}

The Indominus rex twins were two baby Indominus rex that appeared as minor antagonists in the LEGO special LEGO Jurassic World: Double Trouble.

The twins share an identical body shape but with different skin tones. One individual is white with grey markings while the second individual is a dark grey with lighter gray markings. Both twins have deep red eyes.

The white individual is likely inspired by the design of the Indominus rex as it appears in the LEGO Jurassic World video game and the 2015 set 75919 Indominus rex Breakout , while the grey individual is likely inspired by the design of the Indominus rex in the 2020 LEGO set 75941 Indominus Rex vs. Ankylosaurus.
